title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Phone Payment Fee and Reliance on Phone Agents
content:
**Channel guidance.** The phone payment fee on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account follows how often the borrower relies on agents: a borrower not enrolled in autopay whose payments taken through a phone agent in the twelve months before the day the fee is entered on the account, the named payment included, reach the frequent-caller count of 3 pays the frequent-caller fee of 12.95; a borrower enrolled in autopay with at most one such payment in those twelve months pays the courtesy fee of 4.95; every other borrower pays the plan's phone payment fee.

The twelve months are counted back from the day the fee is entered on the account, whatever earlier posting date the fee itself carries. The payments counted are the payments on the account taken through a phone agent and posted in those twelve months, including the payment the fee names.

## Fee by reliance

| Autopay | Phone-agent payments in the 12 months (named payment included) | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Not enrolled | 3 or more | 12.95 |
| Not enrolled | 1 or 2 | The plan's phone payment fee |
| Enrolled | 1 (or none) | 4.95 |
| Enrolled | 2 or more | The plan's phone payment fee |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical borrowers)

- Not enrolled in autopay, 3 phone-agent payments in the twelve months: 12.95; 2 payments: the plan's phone payment fee.
- Enrolled in autopay, the named payment the only phone-agent payment in the twelve months: 4.95; one more phone-agent payment in the window: the plan's phone payment fee.
- A phone-agent payment posted thirteen months before the day the fee is entered is outside the twelve months and is not counted.
